_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 11-14 November 2025: the cold war, Venezuela and plague sessions.

mentions.claim_text: He says to go back to Taiwan and South Korea, and that a cold war will become even colder.
mentions.quote: go back to Taiwan, South Korea, a cold war to even be colder
mentions.falsify_match: A sharp deterioration in relations centred on Taiwan and South Korea.
mentions.falsify_miss: Relations stay as they are. Colder has no threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the phrase about a cold war becoming colder and asks the Lord aloud what the statement means, saying he is curious and wants to see more.
mentions.quote: A cold war that would be colder. What does that mean?
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: he asks what his own phrase means and does not answer it.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says Kim Jong-un has been promised a lot by Putin through a major plan and will act out a lot in the days ahead because they are desperate for him.
mentions.quote: He's been promised a lot by Putin
mentions.falsify_match: North Korean provocations traceable to Russian inducements.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. North Korean troops in Russia were already reported from late 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He says Venezuela is the same case of finding allies, that the cold war will become much colder, and tells them to remember Cuba and the Cuban missile crisis.
mentions.quote: Remember Cuba. I see the Cuban missile crisis
mentions.falsify_match: A missile crisis style standoff over Cuba or Venezuela.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated, though the parallel is specific enough to recognise.

mentions.claim_text: He says the south does not want to be forgotten, and that he sees troops, then peace, then water, then Australia.
mentions.quote: So, I see peace and I see water and then I see Australia
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a sequence of uninterpreted images.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says Australia is watching to see what happens, but that it is all concerning Europe and concerning Kim.
mentions.quote: it's all concerning Europe it's all concerning Kim
mentions.falsify_match: Australia drawn into a European and Korean crisis.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. No act is attached.

mentions.claim_text: He explains the cruise ship behind him as the beginning of the turn, saying a boat takes a long time to turn around while a plane can change direction quickly.
mentions.quote: This is the beginning of the turn
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an illustration about the pace of change.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he tells them what the Lord tells him to say and is doing the best he can, then turns to what he saw concerning Israel.
mentions.quote: I tell you what the Lord tells us to say
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a statement about his own practice.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him that night they must pray for Venezuela, and asks for a little longer before closing.
mentions.quote: We must pray for Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an instruction to pray, with no event attached.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He describes it as a game of chess about staying on top and holding the world's reserve currency, with strategic allies in play.
mentions.quote: How do you stay the world's reserve currency
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a framing of great power competition over reserve currency status.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees big oil rigs around Venezuela, prompted by his wife for the word, and that this has to do with BRICS.
mentions.quote: That's what I see around Venezuela. Big oil rigs
mentions.falsify_match: Venezuelan offshore oil becoming a BRICS lever.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Venezuela holds the largest proved oil reserves in the world, which is public.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are many 9/11s and many shakings coming, not all on the same day though some will be, coming back to back to create instability.
mentions.quote: back to back to back to back to create an unstable
mentions.falsify_match: A rapid series of mass casualty attacks in America.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated, and the many-small-9/11s framing means no single event is required.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a flash and that he saw a man on the stage but never told them, and that there are things he will never reveal.
mentions.quote: There's things that I'll never reveal
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: material stated to exist and permanently withheld. The third withholding on file.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He corrects a figure to fifteen million rather than fifteen billion, reasoning that fifteen million is easier to hide inside a trillion dollar budget.
mentions.quote: 15 million, not 15 billion. 15 million is easier to hide
mentions.falsify_match: A fifteen million dollar item found concealed in a federal budget.
mentions.falsify_miss: None found. No agency or programme is named.

mentions.claim_text: He says a figure in Israel will be taken out and it will shake the nation, that old faces come back because of this man, and reports the Lord saying the third temple will be negotiated soon.
mentions.quote: figure in Israel be taken out. It will shake the nation
mentions.falsify_match: A senior Israeli figure killed or removed, followed by temple negotiations.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. The figure is not named, which is the gap.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the man's face and that this one pushes the thing down, but that it is part seeing and part hearing and he has to pray about it.
mentions.quote: I saw his face. He's the one that pushes down the thing
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a face seen and not named, with the act left as the thing.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what if it is not terrorists, and recalls the arrow that went to Ukraine and back to Russia.
mentions.quote: What if it's not terrorists?
mentions.falsify_match: An attack attributed to a state rather than to terrorists.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Posed as a question, which is as far as he takes it.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why they would hurt their own, repeats the question about terrorists, and ties the Ukraine and Russia arrow to what he saw over Israel.
mentions.quote: why would they try to hurt their own?
mentions.falsify_match: A false flag attack established as such.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Left entirely as a question.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls a terrible ice storm seen in shades of pink, purple and black running up through Arkansas, Tennessee and Kentucky.
mentions.quote: it was ice storm that was terrible that went clear up through Arkansas
mentions.falsify_match: A severe ice storm across Arkansas, Tennessee and Kentucky.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Three named states in a corridor that gets ice storms most winters, which is the base rate problem.

mentions.claim_text: He says it starts in Europe with rats released from a lab like the bubonic plague, spliced through AI technology, released in key places, spreading and reaching the animals.
mentions.quote: start in Europe with rats. rats from a lab
mentions.falsify_match: A laboratory-engineered plague released in Europe through rodents.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The mechanism, the vector and the continent are all named, which makes this the most specific form of the plague claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is speaking to New Zealand, Asia, Africa, Europe and South America, and that people are mistaken to think it is all about America because it is about the Western thing.
mentions.quote: You are mistaken. It's not about America
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a correction to his audience about scope.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Panama Canal and the drug trade routes concern China, and that there will be an escalation over Venezuela and an overthrowing of power like Iraq and Saddam.
mentions.quote: An overthrowing of an power. Just like it was with Iraq and Saddam
mentions.falsify_match: Regime change in Venezuela on the Iraq model.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named country and a named precedent, which makes this checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says a tyrant is removed so revival can come within it, and that he sees Putin coming to Venezuela's aid, which could be the powder keg for a greater escalation of war.
mentions.quote: I see Putin coming to the aid of Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: Russian military support for Venezuela against American action.
mentions.falsify_miss: None provided. A named state and a named client, which is checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says they must put a kink in the hose, seeing a kink in a water hose, concerning Putin's strategic allies and a darkness.
mentions.quote: We must put a kink in the hose
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an instruction to pray, with the hose left uninterpreted.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says not to forget the Cuban missile crisis, names Trump and Russia and old alliances, and says he sees a darkness on Cuba that is already dated.
mentions.quote: I see a darkness on Cuba. It's dated already
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuba crisis on the 1962 model.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He says it is dated already but does not give the date.

mentions.claim_text: He says to remember that Venezuela will be like an Iraq if it keeps going this way.
mentions.quote: Venezuela will be like an Iraq
mentions.falsify_match: A US-led war and occupation in Venezuela on the Iraq model.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The conditional keeps it open but the comparison sets a recognisable shape.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions a scandal, then Iran, then the secretary of state, whose name he gropes for and does not settle.
mentions.quote: like scandal and then you see Iran and the secretary of state
mentions.falsify_match: A scandal involving the secretary of state and Iran.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He cannot retrieve the name, which leaves the subject unfixed.

mentions.claim_text: He prays against a darkness over New York which he describes as a quilt, and wonders whether people living there can feel it.
mentions.quote: it's like a quilt of darkness
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a spiritual darkness over a city has no observable measure.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what kind of government follows, and describes a proxy puppet government similar to what they want with Zelenskyy and an elderly grey-haired man, with Zelenskyy going bye-bye.
mentions.quote: I saw a puppet government come in
mentions.falsify_match: Zelenskyy replaced by an older grey-haired figure heading a proxy government.
mentions.falsify_miss: He is not. The physical description is the checkable part.

mentions.claim_text: Praying peace over the nation and over Arkansas, Oklahoma and Texas, he says he sees money used to influence into Ukraine and asks whether he should say it aloud.
mentions.quote: This money is to influence into Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: US money shown to have been used for political influence in Ukraine.
mentions.falsify_miss: None shown. The earliest telling of the Ukraine money material, three weeks before the Washington to Kyiv arrow.
